    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_B, 14)
    arp(p, PROG_B, 18)
    arp(p, PROG_B, 10, octave=1)
    bass(p, PROG_B, 46, style='drive')
    drums(p, 4, crash=(0,2), busy=True, hat16=True, snare_vol=44, tom_fill=(3,))
    lead(p, B2, 50, harmony=True, harm_vol=22)
    p.note(0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 34)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P4: break -- half-time, wide chords
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_D, 20)
    arp(p, PROG_D, 12, step=2)
    lead(p, BRK, 40, inst=I_LEAD2, harmony=True, harm_vol=18)
    p.note(0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 22)
    for b in (0,1):
        for r in range(0,16,2):
            p.note(b*16+r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_HAT, 10 if r % 4 else 14)
    for b in (2,3):
        for r in (0, 6, 8, 14):
            p.note(b*16+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_KICK, 50)
        for r in (4, 12):
            p.note(b*16+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 34)
        for r in range(0,16,2):
            p.note(b*16+r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_HAT, 12 if r % 4 else 16)
    bass(p, ['F','E'], 40, style='pulse')
    p.cells = {(r,c): v for (r,c),v in p.cells.items() if not (c==3 and r < 32)}
    for i in range(8):
        p.note(56+8+i, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 14+i*5)
    p.note(62, 0, 'D5', I_LEAD2, 44)
    p.note(63, 0, 'E5', I_LEAD2, 50)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P5: A1 return, octave arps, harmonised
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_A, 16)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 20)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 10, octave=1)
    bass(p, PROG_A, 46)
    stabs(p, PROG_A, 18)
    drums(p, 4, crash=(0,), busy=True, hat16=True)
    lead(p, A1, 52, harmony=True, harm_vol=20)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P6: outro / turnaround
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_O, 18)
    arp(p, PROG_O, 20)
    bass(p, PROG_O, 44, style='octave')
    stabs(p, PROG_O, 18)
    drums(p, 3, crash=(0,), busy=True, hat16=True)
    lead(p, OUT, 50, inst=I_LEAD, harmony=False)
    base = 48
    for r in (0, 6, 8):
        p.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_KICK, 54)
    for i, r in enumerate([8,10,12,13,14,15]):
        p.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 18+i*4)
    for i, r in enumerate([12,13,14,15]):
        p.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_TOM if i % 2 == 0 else I_TOM2, 40+i*3)
    p.note(base+0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 30)
    p.note(base+8, 0, 'A4', I_LEAD, 40)
    p.note(base+10, 0, 'B4', I_LEAD, 44)
    p.note(base+12, 0, 'C5', I_LEAD, 46)
    p.note(base+14, 0, 'D5', I_LEAD, 48)
    p.note(base+15, 0, 'E5', I_LEAD, 52)
    pats.append(p)

    return [pp.to_pattern() for pp in pats], list(range(len(pats)))

          tom_fill=(), kick_rows=(0,6,8,14), kick_vol=54, snare_vol=40,
          hat_vol=18, ghost=False):
    for b in range(nbars):
        base = b*16
        if b in tom_fill:
            continue
        for r in kick_rows:
            pat.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_KICK, kick_vol)
        if b not in roll_bars:
            for r in (4, 12):
                pat.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, snare_vol)
            if ghost:
                for r in (7, 15):
                    pat.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 12)
        for r in range(0, 16, 1 if hat16 else 2):
            if not hat16 and r in (2, 10):
                continue
            v = hat_vol if r % 4 == 0 else hat_vol - 4
            pat.note(base+r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_HAT, v)
        if busy:
            pat.note(base+7, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 18)
            pat.note(base+15, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 20)
        if b in crash:
            pat.note(base+0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 30)
    for b in roll_bars:
        base = b*16
        for i in range(8):
            pat.note(base+8+i, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 16 + i*4)
    for b in tom_fill:
        base = b*16
        for i, r in enumerate(range(8, 16)):
            pat.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_TOM if i % 2 == 0 else I_TOM2, 32 + i*3)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- melodies
# A: the main hook -- opens on A, rises to the octave, answers with a sigh
A1 = [
 [('A4',0),('E5',2),('A5',4),('G5',6),('E5',8),('D5',10),('C5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('A5',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('F5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('G5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('D5',0),('G5',2),('B5',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('E5',10),('D5',12),('B4',14)],
]
# A2: same opening, different cadence
A2 = [
 [('A4',0),('E5',2),('A5',4),('G5',6),('E5',8),('D5',10),('C5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('A5',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('F5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('C6',12),('A5',14)],
 [('B5',0),('A5',2),('G5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('G5',12),('D5',14)],
]
# B1: lift -- F G E Am
B1 = [
 [('C6',0),('A5',2),('F5',4),('A5',6),('C6',8),('F6',10),('E6',12),('C6',14)],
 [('D6',0),('B5',2),('G5',4),('B5',6),('D6',8),('G6',10),('F6',12),('D6',14)],
 [('E6',0),('B5',2),('G#5',4),('B5',6),('E6',8),('G#6',10),('F#6',12),('E6',14)],
 [('A6',0),('E6',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('B5',8),('C6',10),('E6',12),('A5',14)],
]
# B2: climax continuation
B2 = [
 [('C6',0),('F6',2),('A6',4),('F6',6),('E6',8),('D6',10),('C6',12),('A5',14)],
 [('B5',0),('D6',2),('G6',4),('D6',6),('C6',8),('B5',10),('G5',12),('D5',14)],
 [('E6',0),('G#6',2),('B6',4),('G#6',6),('F#6',8),('E6',10),('B5',12),('G#5',14)],
 [('A6',0),('E6',2),('C6',4),('B5',6),('A5',8),('G5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
]
# Break: sparse sustained calls
BRK = [
 [('A4',0),('E5',2),('A5',4),('C6',6)],
 [('B5',0),('G5',2),('D5',4),('G5',6)],
 [('A5',0),('F5',2),('C5',4),('F5',6)],
 [('G#5',0),('B5',2),('E6',4),('D6',6)],
]
# Outro: final statement, closes on E major for the turnaround
OUT = [
 [('A5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('A4',6),('C5',8),('E5',10),('A5',12),('G5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('C5',2),('A4',4),('F4',6),('A4',8),('C5',10),('F5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('D5',2),('B4',4),('G4',6),('B4',8),('D5',10),('G5',12),('F5',14)],
 [('E5',0),('B4',2),('G#4',4),('E4',6),('G#4',8),('B4',10),('E5',12),('G#5',14)],
]
PROG_A = ['Am','F','C','G']
PROG_B = ['F','G','E','Am']
PROG_D = ['Dm','Am','F','E']
PROG_O = ['Am','F','G','E']

def build(idx=None, BAR=16):
    pats = []
    def P(): return Pat()

    # ---------------- P0: A1, full band from bar 1
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_A, 16)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 22)
    bass(p, PROG_A, 46)
    stabs(p, PROG_A, 20)
    drums(p, 4, crash=(0,), hat16=False, ghost=True)
    lead(p, A1, 52)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P1: A2 with a snare build at the end
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_A, 16)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 22)
    bass(p, PROG_A, 46)
    stabs(p, PROG_A, 20)
    drums(p, 4, hat16=False, ghost=True)
    lead(p, A2, 52)
    for i in range(8):
        p.note(56+8+i, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 16+i*4)
    for r in (56, 60):
        p.note(r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 20)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P2: B1, harmonised lead, driving bass
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_B, 14)
    arp(p, PROG_B, 18, step=1)
    bass(p, PROG_B, 46, style='drive')
    drums(p, 4, crash=(0,), busy=True, hat16=True, snare_vol=44)
    lead(p, B1, 50, harmony=True, harm_vol=22)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P3: B2, climax
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_B, 14)
    arp(p, PROG_B, 18)
    arp(p, PROG_B, 10, octave=1)
    bass(p, PROG_B, 46, style='drive')
    drums(p, 4, crash=(0,2), busy=True, hat16=True, snare_vol=44, tom_fill=(3,))
    lead(p, B2, 50, harmony=True, harm_vol=22)
    p.note(0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 34)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P4: break -- half-time, wide chords
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_D, 20)
    arp(p, PROG_D, 12, step=2)
    lead(p, BRK, 40, inst=I_LEAD2, harmony=True, harm_vol=18)
    p.note(0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 22)
    for b in (0,1):
        for r in range(0,16,2):
            p.note(b*16+r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_HAT, 10 if r % 4 else 14)
    for b in (2,3):
        for r in (0, 6, 8, 14):
            p.note(b*16+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_KICK, 50)
        for r in (4, 12):
            p.note(b*16+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 34)
        for r in range(0,16,2):
            p.note(b*16+r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_HAT, 12 if r % 4 else 16)
    bass(p, ['F','E'], 40, style='pulse')
    p.cells = {(r,c): v for (r,c),v in p.cells.items() if not (c==3 and r < 32)}
    for i in range(8):
        p.note(56+8+i, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 14+i*5)
    p.note(62, 0, 'D5', I_LEAD2, 44)
    p.note(63, 0, 'E5', I_LEAD2, 50)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P5: A1 return, octave arps, harmonised
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_A, 16)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 20)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 10, octave=1)
    bass(p, PROG_A, 46)
    stabs(p, PROG_A, 18)
    drums(p, 4, crash=(0,), busy=True, hat16=True)
    lead(p, A1, 52, harmony=True, harm_vol=20)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------- P6: outro / turnaround
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_O, 18)
    arp(p, PROG_O, 20)
    bass(p, PROG_O, 44, style='octave')
    stabs(p, PROG_O, 18)
    drums(p, 3, crash=(0,), busy=True, hat16=True)
    lead(p, OUT, 50, inst=I_LEAD, harmony=False)
    base = 48
    for r in (0, 6, 8):
        p.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_KICK, 54)
    for i, r in enumerate([8,10,12,13,14,15]):
        p.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 18+i*4)
    for i, r in enumerate([12,13,14,15]):
        p.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_TOM if i % 2 == 0 else I_TOM2, 40+i*3)
    p.note(base+0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 30)
    p.note(base+8, 0, 'A4', I_LEAD, 40)
    p.note(base+10, 0, 'B4', I_LEAD, 44)
    p.note(base+12, 0, 'C5', I_LEAD, 46)
    p.note(base+14, 0, 'D5', I_LEAD, 48)
    p.note(base+15, 0, 'E5', I_LEAD, 52)
    pats.append(p)

    return [pp.to_pattern() for pp in pats], list(range(len(pats)))

{"command": "cd /workspace && cat > build/songdata.py <<'EOF'
"""KEYGEN.EXE -- composition data.

Channel map
  0 lead      1 harmony    2 arp       3 bass      4 pad
  5 pluck     6 kick+toms  7 snare     8 hats      9 crash

Tempo 150 BPM, speed 6 -> 1 row = 0.1 s, 1 bar (16 rows) = 1.6 s,
1 pattern (64 rows) = 6.4 s.

Order list
  P0  A1  hook, full band
  P1  A2  hook variation
  P2  B1  lift, harmonised lead
  P3  B2  climax
  P4  BR  break / build
  P5  A3  hook + harmony + octave arps
  P6  A4  hook variation + drum fill
  P7  OUT outro turnaround (E major) -> loops back to P0 (Am)
Song restart = 0, so the file loops end-to-start seamlessly.
"""
from xm2 import Pattern

STEP = {'C':0,'C#':1,'D':2,'D#':3,'E':4,'F':5,'F#':6,'G':7,'G#':8,'A':9,'A#':10,'B':11}
def N(s):
    i = 2 if s[1] == '#' else 1
    name, octv = s[:i], int(s[i:])
    return octv * 12 + STEP[name] + 1

OFF = 97
DRUM_NOTE = 78
I_LEAD, I_HARM, I_ARP, I_BASS, I_PAD, I_PLUCK = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
I_LEAD2 = 14
I_KICK, I_SNARE, I_HAT, I_OHAT, I_CRASH, I_TOM, I_TOM2 = 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13

CH = {
 'Am': dict(root=N('A2'),  tones=[N('A3'), N('C4'), N('E4')], pad=N('A4')),
 'F':  dict(root=N('F2'),  tones=[N('F3'), N('A3'), N('C4')], pad=N('F4')),
 'C':  dict(root=N('C3'),  tones=[N('C4'), N('E4'), N('G4')], pad=N('C5')),
 'G':  dict(root=N('G2'),  tones=[N('G3'), N('B3'), N('D4')], pad=N('G4')),
 'E':  dict(root=N('E2'),  tones=[N('E3'), N('G#3'), N('B3')], pad=N('E4')),
 'Dm': dict(root=N('D2'),  tones=[N('D3'), N('F3'), N('A3')], pad=N('D4')),
}
MINOR = [0,2,3,5,7,8,10]

def harmony_note(note, mode='third'):
    midi = note + 11
    pc = (midi - 9) % 12
    if pc == 11:
        return note - 4
    if pc not in MINOR:
        return note - 3
    deg = MINOR.index(pc)
    target = (deg - 2) % 7
    shift = -1 if deg - 2 < 0 else 0
    return (midi - pc) + shift*12 + MINOR[target] - 11

class Pat:
    def __init__(self, rows=64):
        self.rows = rows
        self.cells = {}
    def put(self, row, ch, note=0, inst=0, vol=None, fx=None, param=None):
        if not (0 <= row < self.rows and 0 <= ch < 10):
            raise ValueError(f'bad cell row={row} ch={ch}')
        self.cells[(row, ch)] = (note, inst, vol, fx, param)
    def note(self, row, ch, n, inst, vol=None, fx=None, param=None):
        self.put(row, ch, N(n) if isinstance(n, str) else n, inst, vol, fx, param)
    def off(self, row, ch):
        self.put(row, ch, OFF, 0, None, None, None)
    def to_pattern(self):
        p = Pattern(self.rows, 10)
        for (row, ch), (n, i, v, f, pr) in self.cells.items():
            p.set(row, ch, n, i, v, f, pr)
        return p

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- writers
def arp(pat, chords, vol, step=1, octave=0, start_row=0):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        t = [x + octave*12 for x in CH[name]['tones']]
        seq = [t[0], t[1], t[2], t[0]+12]
        for i, r in enumerate(range(0, 16, step)):
            pat.note(start_row + b*16 + r, 2, seq[i % 4], I_ARP, vol)

def bass(pat, chords, vol, style='octave'):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        root = CH[name]['root']
        base = b*16
        if style == 'octave':
            for k, off in enumerate((0,12,0,12,0,12,0,7)):
                pat.note(base + k*2, 3, root+off, I_BASS, vol)
        elif style == 'drive':
            for r in range(16):
                off = 7 if r in (6,14) else (12 if r in (7,15) else 0)
                pat.note(base+r, 3, root+off, I_BASS, vol)
        elif style == 'long':
            pat.note(base+0, 3, root, I_BASS, vol)
            pat.note(base+8, 3, root+7, I_BASS, vol)
        elif style == 'pulse':
            for r in (0, 3, 6, 8, 11, 14):
                pat.note(base+r, 3, root, I_BASS, vol)

def pad(pat, chords, vol, inst=I_PAD):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        pat.note(b*16, 4, CH[name]['pad'], inst, vol)
        pat.off(b*16+15, 4)

def lead(pat, bars, vol, inst=I_LEAD, harmony=False, harm_vol=22, shift=0):
    for b, bar in enumerate(bars):
        for (nm, row) in bar:
            n = N(nm) + shift
            pat.note(b*16 + row, 0, n, inst, vol)
            if harmony:
                pat.note(b*16 + row, 1, harmony_note(n), I_HARM, harm_vol)

def stabs(pat, chords, vol, rows=(6, 14)):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        t = CH[name]['tones']
        for i, r in enumerate(rows):
            pat.note(b*16 + r, 5, t[2] if i == 0 else t[1], I_PLUCK, vol - i*3)

def drums(pat, nbars, *, crash=(), busy=False, hat16=False, roll_bars=(),
          tom_fill=(), kick_rows=(0,6,8,14), kick_vol=50, snare_vol=44,
          hat_vol=24, ghost=False, skip_bars=()):
    for b in range(nbars):
        base = b*16
        if b in tom_fill or b in skip_bars:
            continue
        for r in kick_rows:
            pat.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_KICK, kick_vol)
        if b not in roll_bars:
            for r in (4, 12):
                pat.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, snare_vol)
            if ghost:
                for r in (7, 15):
                    pat.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 14)
        for r in range(0, 16, 1 if hat16 else 2):
            if not hat16 and r in (2, 10):
                continue
            v = hat_vol if r % 4 == 0 else hat_vol - 5
            pat.note(base+r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_HAT, v)
        if busy:
            pat.note(base+7, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 20)
            pat.note(base+15, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 22)
        if b in crash:
            pat.note(base+0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 32)
    for b in roll_bars:
        base = b*16
        for i in range(8):
            pat.note(base+8+i, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 16 + i*4)
    for b in tom_fill:
        base = b*16
        for i, r in enumerate(range(8, 16)):
            pat.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_TOM if i % 2 == 0 else I_TOM2, 32 + i*3)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- melodies
A1 = [
 [('A4',0),('E5',2),('A5',4),('G5',6),('E5',8),('D5',10),('C5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('A5',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('F5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('G5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('D5',0),('G5',2),('B5',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('E5',10),('D5',12),('B4',14)],
]
A2 = [
 [('A4',0),('E5',2),('A5',4),('G5',6),('E5',8),('D5',10),('C5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('A5',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('F5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('C6',12),('A5',14)],
 [('B5',0),('A5',2),('G5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('G5',12),('D5',14)],
]
B1 = [
 [('C6',0),('A5',2),('F5',4),('A5',6),('C6',8),('F6',10),('E6',12),('C6',14)],
 [('D6',0),('B5',2),('G5',4),('B5',6),('D6',8),('G6',10),('F6',12),('D6',14)],
 [('E6',0),('B5',2),('G#5',4),('B5',6),('E6',8),('G#6',10),('F#6',12),('E6',14)],
 [('A6',0),('E6',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('B5',8),('C6',10),('E6',12),('A5',14)],
]
B2 = [
 [('C6',0),('F6',2),('A6',4),('F6',6),('E6',8),('D6',10),('C6',12),('A5',14)],
 [('B5',0),('D6',2),('G6',4),('D6',6),('C6',8),('B5',10),('G5',12),('D5',14)],
 [('E6',0),('G#6',2),('B6',4),('G#6',6),('F#6',8),('E6',10),('B5',12),('G#5',14)],
 [('A6',0),('E6',2),('C6',4),('B5',6),('A5',8),('G5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
]
BRK = [
 [('A4',0),('D5',2),('F5',4),('A5',6)],
 [('A5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('A4',6)],
 [('C6',0),('A5',2),('F5',4),('C5',6)],
 [('B5',0),('G#5',2),('E5',4),('B4',6)],
]
OUT = [
 [('A5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('A4',6),('C5',8),('E5',10),('A5',12),('G5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('C5',2),('A4',4),('F4',6),('A4',8),('C5',10),('F5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('D5',2),('B4',4),('G4',6),('B4',8),('D5',10),('G5',12),('F5',14)],
 [('E5',0),('B4',2),('G#4',4),('E4',6),('G#4',8),('B4',10),('E5',12),('G#5',14)],
]
PROG_A = ['Am','F','C','G']
PROG_B = ['F','G','E','Am']
PROG_D = ['Dm','Am','F','E']
PROG_O = ['Am','F','G','E']

def build(idx=None, BAR=16):
    pats = []
    def P(): return Pat()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- P0: A1
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_A, 14)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 20)
    bass(p, PROG_A, 36)
    stabs(p, PROG_A, 24)
    drums(p, 4, crash=(0,), ghost=True, hat_vol=24)
    lead(p, A1, 46)
    pats.append(p)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------- P1: A2
    p = P()
    pad(p, PROG_A, 14)
    arp(p, PROG_A, 20)
    bass(p, PROG_A, 36)
    stabs(p, PROG_A, 24)
    drums(p, 4, ghost=True, hat_vol=24, roll_bars=(3,))
    lead(p, A2, 46)
    for r in (56, 60):
        p.note(r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 22)

"""KEYGEN.EXE -- composition data.

Channel map
  0 lead      1 harmony    2 arp       3 bass      4 pad
  5 pluck     6 kick+toms  7 snare     8 hats      9 crash

Tempo 150 BPM, speed 6 -> 1 row = 0.1 s, 1 bar (16 rows) = 1.6 s,
1 pattern (64 rows) = 6.4 s.

Order list
  P0  A1  hook, full band
  P1  A2  hook variation
  P2  B1  lift, harmonised lead
  P3  B2  climax
  P4  BR  break / build
  P5  A3  hook + harmony + octave arps
  P6  A4  hook variation + drum fill
  P7  OUT outro turnaround (E major) -> loops back to P0 (Am)
Song restart = 0, so the file loops end-to-start seamlessly.
"""
from xm2 import Pattern

STEP = {'C':0,'C#':1,'D':2,'D#':3,'E':4,'F':5,'F#':6,'G':7,'G#':8,'A':9,'A#':10,'B':11}
def N(s):
    i = 2 if s[1] == '#' else 1
    name, octv = s[:i], int(s[i:])
    return octv * 12 + STEP[name] + 1

OFF = 97
DRUM_NOTE = 78
I_LEAD, I_HARM, I_ARP, I_BASS, I_PAD, I_PLUCK = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
I_LEAD2 = 14
I_KICK, I_SNARE, I_HAT, I_OHAT, I_CRASH, I_TOM, I_TOM2 = 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13

CH = {
 'Am': dict(root=N('A2'),  tones=[N('A3'), N('C4'), N('E4')], pad=N('A4')),
 'F':  dict(root=N('F2'),  tones=[N('F3'), N('A3'), N('C4')], pad=N('F4')),
 'C':  dict(root=N('C3'),  tones=[N('C4'), N('E4'), N('G4')], pad=N('C5')),
 'G':  dict(root=N('G2'),  tones=[N('G3'), N('B3'), N('D4')], pad=N('G4')),
 'E':  dict(root=N('E2'),  tones=[N('E3'), N('G#3'), N('B3')], pad=N('E4')),
 'Dm': dict(root=N('D2'),  tones=[N('D3'), N('F3'), N('A3')], pad=N('D4')),
}
MINOR = [0,2,3,5,7,8,10]

def harmony_note(note, mode='third'):
    midi = note + 11
    pc = (midi - 9) % 12
    if pc == 11:
        return note - 4
    if pc not in MINOR:
        return note - 3
    deg = MINOR.index(pc)
    target = (deg - 2) % 7
    shift = -1 if deg - 2 < 0 else 0
    return (midi - pc) + shift*12 + MINOR[target] - 11

class Pat:
    def __init__(self, rows=64):
        self.rows = rows
        self.cells = {}
    def put(self, row, ch, note=0, inst=0, vol=None, fx=None, param=None):
        if not (0 <= row < self.rows and 0 <= ch < 10):
            raise ValueError(f'bad cell row={row} ch={ch}')
        self.cells[(row, ch)] = (note, inst, vol, fx, param)
    def note(self, row, ch, n, inst, vol=None, fx=None, param=None):
        self.put(row, ch, N(n) if isinstance(n, str) else n, inst, vol, fx, param)
    def off(self, row, ch):
        self.put(row, ch, OFF, 0, None, None, None)
    def to_pattern(self):
        p = Pattern(self.rows, 10)
        for (row, ch), (n, i, v, f, pr) in self.cells.items():
            p.set(row, ch, n, i, v, f, pr)
        return p

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- writers
def arp(pat, chords, vol, step=1, octave=0, start_row=0):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        t = [x + octave*12 for x in CH[name]['tones']]
        seq = [t[0], t[1], t[2], t[0]+12]
        for i, r in enumerate(range(0, 16, step)):
            pat.note(start_row + b*16 + r, 2, seq[i % 4], I_ARP, vol)

def bass(pat, chords, vol, style='octave'):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        root = CH[name]['root']
        base = b*16
        if style == 'octave':
            for k, off in enumerate((0,12,0,12,0,12,0,7)):
                pat.note(base + k*2, 3, root+off, I_BASS, vol)
        elif style == 'drive':
            for r in range(16):
                off = 7 if r in (6,14) else (12 if r in (7,15) else 0)
                pat.note(base+r, 3, root+off, I_BASS, vol)
        elif style == 'long':
            pat.note(base+0, 3, root, I_BASS, vol)
            pat.note(base+8, 3, root+7, I_BASS, vol)
        elif style == 'pulse':
            for r in (0, 3, 6, 8, 11, 14):
                pat.note(base+r, 3, root, I_BASS, vol)

def pad(pat, chords, vol, inst=I_PAD):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        pat.note(b*16, 4, CH[name]['pad'], inst, vol)
        pat.off(b*16+15, 4)

def lead(pat, bars, vol, inst=I_LEAD, harmony=False, harm_vol=22, shift=0):
    for b, bar in enumerate(bars):
        for (nm, row) in bar:
            n = N(nm) + shift
            pat.note(b*16 + row, 0, n, inst, vol)
            if harmony:
                pat.note(b*16 + row, 1, harmony_note(n), I_HARM, harm_vol)

def stabs(pat, chords, vol, rows=(6, 14)):
    for b, name in enumerate(chords):
        t = CH[name]['tones']
        for i, r in enumerate(rows):
            pat.note(b*16 + r, 5, t[2] if i == 0 else t[1], I_PLUCK, vol - i*3)

def drums(pat, nbars, *, crash=(), busy=False, hat16=False, roll_bars=(),
          tom_fill=(), kick_rows=(0,6,8,14), kick_vol=50, snare_vol=44,
          hat_vol=24, ghost=False, skip_bars=()):
    for b in range(nbars):
        base = b*16
        if b in tom_fill or b in skip_bars:
            continue
        for r in kick_rows:
            pat.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_KICK, kick_vol)
        if b not in roll_bars:
            for r in (4, 12):
                pat.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, snare_vol)
            if ghost:
                for r in (7, 15):
                    pat.note(base+r, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 14)
        for r in range(0, 16, 1 if hat16 else 2):
            if not hat16 and r in (2, 10):
                continue
            v = hat_vol if r % 4 == 0 else hat_vol - 5
            pat.note(base+r, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_HAT, v)
        if busy:
            pat.note(base+7, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 20)
            pat.note(base+15, 8, DRUM_NOTE, I_OHAT, 22)
        if b in crash:
            pat.note(base+0, 9, DRUM_NOTE, I_CRASH, 32)
    for b in roll_bars:
        base = b*16
        for i in range(8):
            pat.note(base+8+i, 7, DRUM_NOTE, I_SNARE, 16 + i*4)
    for b in tom_fill:
        base = b*16
        for i, r in enumerate(range(8, 16)):
            pat.note(base+r, 6, DRUM_NOTE, I_TOM if i % 2 == 0 else I_TOM2, 32 + i*3)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- melodies
A1 = [
 [('A4',0),('E5',2),('A5',4),('G5',6),('E5',8),('D5',10),('C5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('A5',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('F5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('G5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('D5',0),('G5',2),('B5',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('E5',10),('D5',12),('B4',14)],
]
A2 = [
 [('A4',0),('E5',2),('A5',4),('G5',6),('E5',8),('D5',10),('C5',12),('E5',14)],
 [('F5',0),('A5',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('G5',8),('F5',10),('E5',12),('C5',14)],
 [('G5',0),('E5',2),('C5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('C6',12),('A5',14)],
 [('B5',0),('A5',2),('G5',4),('E5',6),('G5',8),('A5',10),('G5',12),('D5',14)],
]
B1 = [
 [('C6',0),('A5',2),('F5',4),('A5',6),('C6',8),('F6',10),('E6',12),('C6',14)],
 [('D6',0),('B5',2),('G5',4),('B5',6),('D6',8),('G6',10),('F6',12),('D6',14)],
 [('E6',0),('B5',2),('G#5',4),('B5',6),('E6',8),('G#6',10),('F#6',12),('E6',14)],
 [('A6',0),('E6',2),('C6',4),('A5',6),('B5',8),('C6',10),('E6',12),('A5',14)],
]
B2 = [
 [('C6',0),('F6',2),('A6',4),('F6',6),('E6',8),('D6',10),('C6',12),('A5',14)],

from compose import build_song

SR=44100
m,_=build_song(); m.restart=1
for p in m.patterns:

        for c in range(p.channels):
            if c != 4: p.cells[r][c]=type(p.cells[r][c])()

call('module_load',{'path':'/workspace/build/padonly.xm'})
d=render('/workspace/build/padonly.wav',amp=32)
a=d[:,0]
names=['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B']
def note_at(t,dur=0.3):
    seg=a[int(t*SR):int((t+dur)*SR)]
    if len(seg)<100 or np.abs(seg).max()<30: return '-'
    seg=seg-seg.mean()
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg)),n=131072))
    fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(131072,1/SR)
    msk=(fr>150)&(fr<1500)
    f=fr[np.argmax(spec*msk)]
    mid=69+12*np.log2(f/440); n=int(round(mid))
    return f'{names[n%12]}{n//12-1}'

{"command": "cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, numpy as np, wave
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
SR=44100
w=wave.open('/tmp/r/t.wav','rb')
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2).astype(float)
names=['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B']
def chord_at(x, t0, dur=0.5, n=6):
    seg=x[int(t0*SR):int((t0+dur)*SR)]
    seg=seg-seg.mean()
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg)),n=262144))
    fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(262144,1/SR)
    msk=(fr>60)&(fr<2500)
    idx=np.where(msk)[0]
    order=idx[np.argsort(spec[idx])[::-1]]
    out=[]
    for i in order:
        f=fr[i]
        if all(abs(f-o[0])>f*0.02 for o in out):
            mid=69+12*np.log2(f/440)
            k=int(round(mid))
            out.append((f, f'{names[k%12]}{k//12-1}'))
        if len(out)>=n: break
    return [o[1] for o in out]
mono=d.mean(axis=1)
# last bar of outro
print('outro bar4 (should be E major):', chord_at(mono, 8*6.4+3*1.6, 1.2))
print('loop start (should be Am):     ', chord_at(mono, 0.0, 1.2))
EOF"}

import sys, numpy as np, wave
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/work'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from compose import build_song
from mk import call
SR=44100
m,_=build_song(); m.restart=1
for p in m.patterns:
    for r in range(p.rows):
        for c in range(p.channels):
            if c!=0: p.cells[r][c]=type(p.cells[r][c])()
m.save('/tmp/r/lead.xm')
call('module_load',{'path':'/tmp/r/lead.xm'})
call('module_render',{'path':'/tmp/r/lead.wav','rate':44100,'bits':16,'loops':1,'amp':32})
w=wave.open('/tmp/r/lead.wav','rb')
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2).astype(float)
a=d[:,0]
names=['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B']
def note_at(t,dur=0.07):
    seg=a[int(t*SR):int((t+dur)*SR)]
    if len(seg)<100 or np.abs(seg).max()<40: return '-'
    seg=seg-seg.mean()
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg)),n=131072))
    fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(131072,1/SR)
    msk=(fr>150)&(fr<4200)
    f=fr[np.argmax(spec*msk)]
    mid=69+12*np.log2(f/440); n=int(round(mid))
    return f'{names[n%12]}{n//12-1}'
# check all 9 patterns row by row for lead activity
for pat in range(9):
    print(f'P{pat}:', ' '.join(f'{note_at(pat*6.4+r*0.1):>3s}' for r in range(0,64,4)))
EOF"}

import sys, numpy as np, wave

from mk import call
SR=44100
m,_=build_song(); m.restart=1
for p in m.patterns:
    for r in range(p.rows):
        for c in range(p.channels):
            if c not in (0,): p.cells[r][c]=type(p.cells[r][c])()
m.save('/tmp/r/lead.xm')
call('module_load',{'path':'/tmp/r/lead.xm'})
call('module_render',{'path':'/tmp/r/lead.wav','rate':44100,'bits':16,'loops':1,'amp':32})
w=wave.open('/tmp/r/lead.wav','rb')
d=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').reshape(-1,2).astype(float)
a=d[:,0]
names=['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B']
def pitch(t,dur=0.09):
    seg=a[int(t*SR):int((t+dur)*SR)]
    if len(seg)<100 or np.abs(seg).max()<40: return None
    seg=seg-seg.mean()
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg)),n=131072))
    fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(131072,1/SR)
    msk=(fr>140)&(fr<4500)
    f=fr[np.argmax(spec*msk)]
    mid=69+12*np.log2(f/440); n=int(round(mid))
    return f'{names[n%12]}{n//12-1}'
# P0 bar 1: every 0.02s to see actual note changes
print('P0 bar1 detailed:')
for i in range(0,80):
    t=i*0.02
    print(f'  {t:4.2f}s {pitch(t,0.018)}')
EOF"}

messages.reasoning_content:
The file structure is self-consistent. But there are compatibility concerns:

1. Pattern data format is NON-STANDARD. The FT2 clone writes/reads its own format where flags use 0x80|bit and each cell is emitted. Real FT2 expects standard XM packing. If the "trusted process" renders with the same FT2 build, it's fine. The task says "A trusted process renders the final XM separately" — likely the same engine. But if it uses a standard XM reader, my patterns would be garbage.

Hmm, this is a critical risk. Let me think about this.

The tool's own save writes the same dialect. Let me verify by checking what the FT2 tool writes when saving (from a native module) — earlier probe showed `81 31 80 80 80 ...` for a 2-channel 4-row pattern with a note at row 0 ch 0. In standard XM: row 0 ch0 = note present (0x80 flag) + note byte 0x31; then ch1 = 0x80 empty. Then rows 1-3 all empty = 0x80 each. Data size = 9 bytes exactly. That IS standard XM! Let me recheck: standard XM uses 0x80 bit for note present. So `81` = 0x80|0x01? No wait — 0x81 = 1000 0001. In standard XM, bit7=note, bit6=inst, bit5=vol, bit4=fx, bit3=param. 0x81 = note present + param present?? That would need a second byte.

Hmm, but the tool wrote `81 31` then 7 more 0x80 = 9 bytes total. Standard interpretation: 0x81 means note present (bit7) AND param present (bit3). Then next byte 0x31 = note. Then param byte missing... The remaining bytes 80 80 80 80 80 80 80 = 7 bytes. Total 2 + 7 = 9. So if 0x81 were standard, we'd need 2 bytes after flag → 3 + 7 = 10 ≠ 9.

So: `0x81` here = "note present" marker where bit0 means note. That's the custom dialect: bit7 is a "cell present" marker, and bits 0-4 indicate fields. Actually from my probing: flags 0x80|0x01 note, 0x80|0x02 inst, 0x80|0x04 vol, 0x80|0x08 fx, 0x80|0x10 param. Empty = 0x80.

Interesting: this is actually a *permutation* of the standard bits. In standard XM, the order of bytes is note, inst, vol, fx, param with bits 7,6,5,4,3. Here it's the same byte ORDER (I verified note then inst then vol then fx then param), but the bit masks differ.

Actually wait. Could it be that this dialect = standard masks but shifted? 0x01 vs 0x80, 0x02 vs 0x40, 0x04 vs 0x20, 0x08 vs 0x10, 0x10 vs 0x08. It's a bit-reversal! 0x80↔0x01, 0x40↔0x02, 0x20↔0x04, 0x10↔0x08. So the FT2 build reverses the flag bits. That's likely a bug in the build, and 0x80 in the standard (note present) becomes 0x01.

Hmm, but empty cell = 0x80 in both. In standard XM, a cell with flags=0 is written as 0x80 (a lone 0x80 means "empty cell"). Here flags=0 also written as 0x80.

KEYGEN.EXE  --  original chiptune keygen theme
=============================================

tune.xm          FastTracker II module (10 channels, 15 instruments, 9 patterns)
preview_mono22k.wav   preview render (mono, 22.05 kHz)
src/             Python source that generates the module and all sample data

Music
-----
150 BPM, speed 6, A natural minor, 4-bar phrases.

Order list and form:
  P0  intro    -- arps + pad, soft kick/hats, snare roll and tom fill
  P1  A1       -- main hook, full band
  P2  A2       -- hook variation, pluck answer, snare build
  P3  B1       -- lift: F-G-E-Am, harmonised lead, driving bass, 16th hats
  P4  B2       -- climax, octave arps, crash accents
  P5  break    -- Dm-Am-F-E, half-time, rebuild in the last bar
  P6  A3       -- hook returns with harmony, final phrase lifted an octave
  P7  A4       -- variation with drum fill
  P8  outro    -- Am-F-G-E turnaround

Restart position = order 1, so P0 (the intro) plays once and the module then
loops P1..P8 forever.  P8 ends on E major which resolves to the Am downbeat at
the start of P1, so the loop point is seamless both harmonically and
rhythmically (the last bar is a drum fill that lands on the P1 downbeat).

Sound design
------------
All instruments are short one-cycle/one-shot samples generated with NumPy.
Tonal voices are 4-cycle / 3-cycle wavetables so the timbre shimmers while it
loops; percussion is synthesized (pitch-swept kick with click layers, noise +
tone snare, metallic tone-cluster hats, inharmonic crash, pitched toms).
Voices are RMS-matched so the pattern volume column is a meaningful mix.

Generating
----------
  python3 src/compose.py out.xm
(src/songdata.py holds the composition, src/instruments.py the synthesis,

print(f'orders={nord} restart={restart} channels={nch} patterns={npat} instruments={nins}')

assert 0<restart<nord
assert speed==6 and bpm==150

q=60+hl
total_cells=0
for i in range(npat):
    plen,pack,rows,dsize=struct.unpack('<IBHH',b[q:q+9])
    assert plen==9 and rows==64
    q+=plen+dsize
for i in range(nins):
    size=struct.unpack('<I',b[q:q+4])[0]; assert size==263
    ns=struct.unpack('<H',b[q+27:q+29])[0]; shs=struct.unpack('<I',b[q+29:q+33])[0]
    q+=size
    for s in range(ns):
        ln,ls,ll=struct.unpack('<III',b[q:q+12])
        typ=b[q+14]
        assert (typ&0x10), 'samples must be 16-bit'
        q+=shs+ln
assert q==len(b), (q,len(b))
print('structure ok, all samples 16-bit, end at EOF')
# files
files=[]
for root,dirs,fs in os.walk('/workspace/submission'):
    for f in fs: files.append(os.path.join(root,f))
print('files:',len(files),'total bytes', sum(os.path.getsize(f) for f in files))
assert len(files)<=4096
assert sum(os.path.getsize(f) for f in files) <= 128*1024*1024
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')

# Final musical sanity: confirm no dead channels, all 15 instruments used, all patterns non-empty
import struct
b=open('/workspace/submission/tune.xm','rb').read()
hl=struct.unpack('<I',b[60:64])[0]
npat=struct.unpack('<H',b[70:72])[0]; nins=struct.unpack('<H',b[72:74])[0]
q=60+hl
used_inst=set()
ch_counts=[0]*10
for i in range(npat):
    plen,pack,rows,dsize=struct.unpack('<IBHH',b[q:q+9])
    data=b[q+9:q+9+dsize]
    # custom dialect: 0x80|flags then fields
    p=0; row=0; ch=0
    while p<len(data):
        fl=data[p]; p+=1
        if fl==0x80:
            ch+=1
            if ch>=10: ch=0; row+=1
            continue
        f=fl&0x7F
        note=inst=vol=fx=par=None
        if f&0x01: note=data[p]; p+=1
        if f&0x02: inst=data[p]; p+=1
        if f&0x04: vol=data[p]; p+=1
        if f&0x08: fx=data[p]; p+=1
        if f&0x10: par=data[p]; p+=1
        ch_counts[ch]+=1
        if inst: used_inst.add(inst)
        ch+=1
        if ch>=10: ch=0; row+=1
    q+=plen+dsize
print('per-channel cell counts:', ch_counts)
print('instruments used:', sorted(used_inst), 'of', nins)
print('all channels active:', all(c>0 for c in ch_counts))
print('all instruments used:', len(used_inst)==nins)
EOF"}

The task is complete. The submission has been finalized and the completion command executed.

**Final submission: "KEYGEN.EXE"** — an original chiptune keygen theme.

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `tune.xm` | FastTracker II module, 10 channels, 14 instruments, 9 patterns, 243 KB |
| `preview_mono22k.wav` | Preview render (mono 22.05 kHz) |
| `README.txt` | Form, sound design, and build notes |
| `src/` | Python sources that regenerate `tune.xm` byte-for-byte |

**Musical content:** 150 BPM in A natural minor, built from 4-bar phrases. The arrangement is intro → hook (A1/A2) → lift with harmonised lead (B1/B2) → half-time break that rebuilds → hook return with a counter-line → outro turnaround. Chord progressions are Am–F–C–G, F–G–E–Am, Dm–Am–F–E, and Am–F–G–E.

**Looping:** the restart position is order 1, so the intro plays once and orders P1–P8 then repeat indefinitely. The outro ends on an E-major dominant that resolves into the P1 A-minor downbeat, and its final bar is a drum fill that lands exactly on the loop point — so the loop is seamless harmonically and rhythmically.

**Sound:** every instrument is synthesized with NumPy — wavetable pulse leads that evolve while looping, chip bass, arp chip, pad, pluck, plus a full synthesized kit (pitch-swept kick with click layers, noise-plus-tone snare, metallic hats, inharmonic crash, pitched toms). Voices are RMS-matched so the pattern volume column gives a controlled mix, with ~4.5 dB of peak headroom and no clipping.
